get.summary: Read every enumeration the UI renders.

type.description: The stable problem code, such as `urn:qe:problem:rules-violated`.

detail.description: What happened, when the title does not say it all; omitted otherwise.

errors.description: Input path to messages; `''` is the form-level key. Empty unless the status is 400.

code.description: A short snake_case code for the rule, such as `closure_mismatch`.

message.description: What is wrong, written for the person editing the version or the report.

area.description: A module-specific area, such as a dataset tab, a dimension tab or a report section.

itemId.description:
The offending item, as a stored id's digits or, in a change-set preview, the temporary id of an item the change set created;
omitted when the violation names no single item.

itemKey.description: The offending item's key; omitted when the violation names none.

filter.description: Search text that narrows a table to the offending rows; omitted when there is none.

target.description: Where to take the user to fix a violation: an area of the editor, optionally narrowed to one item or a search.

items.description:
One reason a rule rejects a version, a report, a write or a delete: the contract's `Violation`, and with a
`DeleteBlockerCode` as its code, a `DeleteBlocker`.

violations.description: The rule violations (422) or delete blockers (409); omitted otherwise.

traceId.description: The request's trace id on a 500; omitted otherwise.

schema.description:
The one error body of the API (`application/problem+json`, blueprint 01, OI-06): 400 carries `errors`, 409
carries `violations` for delete blockers and `detail` otherwise, 422 carries `violations`, 401, 403 and
404 carry the title only, and 500 carries `traceId`. Built by `Problems`.

schema.description:
The one error body of the API (`application/problem+json`, blueprint 01, OI-06): 400 carries `errors`, 409
carries `violations` for delete blockers and `detail` otherwise, 422 carries `violations`, 401, 403 and
404 carry the title only, and 500 carries `traceId`. Built by `Problems`.

type.description: The stable problem code, such as `urn:qe:problem:rules-violated`.

detail.description: What happened, when the title does not say it all; omitted otherwise.

errors.description: Input path to messages; `''` is the form-level key. Empty unless the status is 400.

code.description: A short snake_case code for the rule, such as `closure_mismatch`.

message.description: What is wrong, written for the person editing the version or the report.

area.description: A module-specific area, such as a dataset tab, a dimension tab or a report section.

itemId.description:
The offending item, as a stored id's digits or, in a change-set preview, the temporary id of an item the change set created;
omitted when the violation names no single item.

itemKey.description: The offending item's key; omitted when the violation names none.

filter.description: Search text that narrows a table to the offending rows; omitted when there is none.

target.description: Where to take the user to fix a violation: an area of the editor, optionally narrowed to one item or a search.

tenantId.description: The tenant identity used in tenant-scoped routes.

isEnabled.description: Whether query routing is enabled for the tenant.

AccessibleTenant.description: A tenant the caller may administer. It deliberately omits the tenant's connection string.

metricKey.description: The key of the variable or calculated measure attributed.

expression.description: The expression the drivers are switched in; required for a variable, null for a measure's own formula.

weightVariableKey.description: The variable that weighs child rows and members when a ratio's change splits into rate, mix and interaction.

drivers.description: The drivers in the order sequential attribution switches them; none for the default drivers.

Attribution.description:
The contract's `Attribution`: how a change in one metric, between two values such as a month and the month before, splits
into the effects of its drivers (`qe_metric_attribution` with its drivers). A metric without one uses the default drivers:
one per metric its formula reads and one `days` driver for `@periodDays` and `@yearDays` (C6).

key.description: Key, unique among the metric's drivers and never `residual`; it names the driver's expanded report column.

inputs.description: The metric keys and `@periodDays` or `@yearDays` of the expression that switch together (`input_keys_json`).

AttributionDriver.description:
The contract's `AttributionDriver`: inputs of an attribution expression that switch together between the two values
compared. Its position among the metric's drivers is its `sort_order`.

dimensionId.description: The dimension defined from the profile; null when it is not defined yet.

AvailableDimensionProfile.description: The contract's `AvailableDimensionProfile`: a profile with the dimension defined from it, if any.

sources.description: Every source member the version maps, by key in ordinal order.

BridgeAllocationSummary.description: The contract's `BridgeAllocationSummary`: how each source member of a version allocates.

versionId.description: Its empty live version 1.

BridgeCreated.description: The contract's `BridgeCreated`: a new bridge and its empty live version 1.

bridge.description: The bridge with its endpoints, versions and bindings.

BridgeEditState.description: The contract's `BridgeEditState`: the bridge change-set aggregate as the editor shows it.

key.description: The bridge key, fixed after creation.

sourceDimensionId.description: The dimension the bridge maps from, fixed after creation.

targetDimensionId.description: The dimension the bridge maps into, fixed after creation.

isEnabled.description: Whether queries may use the bridge: the live version's flag.

oneOf.description: The report source of a report bridge, which is written only through its report; null for an analytical bridge.

source.description: The source dimension, with its live version.

target.description: The target dimension, with its live version.

versions.description: Every version, one per snapshot holding the bridge: the live one first, then frozen ones, newest first.

liveVersionId.description: The live version, which change sets edit.

liveMappingCount.description: The mappings of the live version.

bindings.description: The live dataset bindings that remap through the bridge.

BridgeListItem.description:
The contract's `BridgeListItem`: an analytical or report bridge with its endpoints, version summaries and the bindings that
use it.

id.description: The mapping's id; in a preview, the temporary id of a mapping the change set created.

versionId.description: The bridge version.

factor.description: The coefficient measures with `bridge_factor_behavior = value` apply (B7).

allocationWeight.description: The share of the source's value the target takes.

sourceSelection.description: A `source_selection` value: the source member alone, or with every member under it (report bridges only, B8).

BridgeMapping.description: The contract's `BridgeMapping`: one source member to target member assignment of a version.

id.description: The mapping's stored id, or a client-generated `tmp:<uuid>` for a new mapping.

factor.description: The coefficient measures with `bridge_factor_behavior = value` apply (B7).

allocationWeight.description: The share of the source's value the target takes.

sourceSelection.description: Report bridges only, written by the report editor; absent means `member` (OI-28).

BridgeMappingInput.description: The contract's `BridgeMappingInput`: one mapping of the live version, named by its id.

BridgeOperation.description:
The contract's `BridgeOperation` union, discriminated by `op` and named after the port's edit methods (OI-01). One
change set covers an analytical bridge's identity and its live version's settings and mappings. The derived types are declared in
the contract's order, which the conformance check pairs alternatives by.

versionId.description: The live version; another version refuses the operation.
The live version; another version refuses the operation.

BridgeOperationBridgeMappingSaveOperatio.description: `saveBridgeMapping`: adds the mapping, or replaces the mapping with the same id.

versionId.description: The live version; another version refuses the operation.

BridgeOperationBridgeMappingsReplaceOper.description: `replaceBridgeMappings`: replaces every mapping of the version (bulk paste).

versionId.description: The live version; another version refuses the operation.

BridgeOperationBridgeVersionUpdateOperat.description: `updateBridgeVersion`: changes the live version's cardinality and allocation mode in place (OI-26).

reportId.description: The report the source belongs to.

sourceKey.description: The key of the source whose rows the bridge maps.

BridgeOwner.description: The contract's `BridgeOwner`: the report source a report bridge belongs to (B9, OI-31).

displayName.description: The new display name; absent keeps it.

isEnabled.description: The new availability; absent keeps it.

BridgePatch.description: The contract's `BridgePatch`: the identity fields to change; key and endpoints are fixed after creation.

weightSum.description: The sum of their allocation weights, in decimal.

BridgeSourceAllocation.description: The contract's `BridgeSourceAllocation`: one source member's targets and the sum of its allocation weights.

snapshotId.description: The snapshot the version belongs to.

isLive.description: Whether the version is live, and so editable; a frozen version is read-only.

isEnabled.description: Whether the engine offers the bridge in the version's snapshot.

BridgeVersion.description: The contract's `BridgeVersion`: the live version or a frozen snapshot's version (B10).

mappings.description: The mappings, by source member key, then target member key.

violations.description:
The rule findings on this content: `target.itemId` names the mapping at fault, or `target.itemKey` the source member of
a per-source rule; empty on a saved live version.

BridgeVersionContent.description: The contract's `BridgeVersionContent`: a version, its mappings, the allocation summary and the rule findings.

BridgeVersionPatch.description:
The contract's `BridgeVersionPatch`: the live version's settings, edited in place (OI-26); mappings that no longer comply
become findings.

snapshotId.description: The snapshot the version belongs to.

isLive.description: Whether the version is live, and so editable; a frozen version is read-only.

BridgeVersionSummary.description: The contract's `BridgeVersionSummary`: one version of a bridge list item, with its settings and mapping count.

versionId.description: The version whose settings these are.

snapshotId.description: The snapshot the version belongs to.

isLive.description: Whether the version is live, and so editable; a frozen version is read-only.

key.description: The model's key, fixed after creation (C9).

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency of the model's monetary figures, such as `USD`.

calendarKey.description: The calendar the model's periods follow; `gregorian`.

formulaLanguage.description: A `formula_language_version` value: the grammar of the model's formulas and attribution expressions.

CalcModel.description: The contract's `CalcModel`: a calculation model's identity with one version's settings (`qe_calculation_model_version`).

key.description: The model's key, unique across models and fixed once created.

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency of the model's monetary figures.

CalcModelCreateInput.description: The contract's `CalcModelCreateInput`: a new model, which is created disabled and empty.

CalcModelPatch.description: The contract's `CalcModelPatch`: the settings an `updateModel` operation changes; an absent setting is kept.

key.description: The key requests will name the snapshot by; unique and fixed.

description.description: An optional note, such as the close the capture records.

CaptureSnapshotInput.description: The contract's `CaptureSnapshotInput`: the key and labels of a frozen snapshot to capture.
